description:
Bridge ACTION: lines in notes/ and logs/ into anchored TASK: lines, and mutate those anchors. Source notes and logs are the store; there is no backend.

Usage with no subcommand: ingest every ACTION: line found in notes/ and logs/, rewriting each in place to a TASK: anchor with a fresh 8-char uuid. Flags: --dry-run (show what would be ingested, write nothing), --quiet (suppress per-action output). These two flags apply ONLY to the no-subcommand invocation.

Subcommands:
  add THREAD TEXT [--due YYYY-MM-DD] [--scheduled YYYY-MM-DD] [--priority H|M|L] [--depends UUID8] — buffer-append a structured ACTION; delegates to `buffer add-action`. THREAD is a label like Projects/SGB. TEXT is '(Assignee) description' or just 'description'.
  done UUID — flip the source TASK: to DONE: and stamp end with today's date.
  set-description UUID TEXT — rewrite the anchor body.
  set-assignee UUID PERSON — rewrite the (Assignee) prefix.
  set-due UUID DATE — set due date, YYYY-MM-DD.
  set-scheduled UUID DATE — set scheduled date, YYYY-MM-DD.
  set-priority UUID PRIORITY — set priority H, M or L; written as [#X] in the visible portion.
  add-depends UUID DEP_UUID — add a depends entry.
  rm-depends UUID DEP_UUID — remove a depends entry.
  list [--priority H|M|L] [--thread T] [--assignee A] [--overdue] — list pending tasks, formatted.
  next — top 5 pending tasks by (priority, due, entry).
  show UUID — detail view of one anchor.

Flags:
  add: --due YYYY-MM-DD; --scheduled YYYY-MM-DD; --priority one of H, M, L; --depends 8-char uuid prefix, repeatable for multiple dependencies.
  list: --priority filters to a single priority (H, M, L); --thread filters to tasks whose source note carries that thread, e.g. Processes/SGB; --assignee filters to tasks assigned to that person; --overdue shows only tasks whose due date is before today.

Examples:
  ["add", "Projects/SGB", "(Riaz Arbi) Send the quarterly report", "--due", "2026-06-15", "--priority", "H"]
  ["list", "--overdue", "--assignee", "Riaz Arbi"]
  ["set-due", "abcd1234", "2026-06-15"]
  ["done", "abcd1234"]

Notes:
  UUID arguments accept an 8-char uuid or a unique prefix of one.
  `add` only queues an ACTION in the buffer; it does not create an anchor. The anchor appears after `buffer flush` writes the line to a log and a no-subcommand `tasks` run ingests it. Only then does a uuid exist to mutate.
  Mutating subcommands rewrite the source note or log file in place.
  Exit code 1 on: no task matching the uuid prefix; an ambiguous uuid prefix; an assignee that does not resolve to people/<person>.md; an empty description; a task made to depend on itself.
  Do not hand-write TASK: or DONE: lines; only this tool writes them.
